action.name: 内部前馈正弦测试
action.command: SET SPEEDPARA: OBJECT="ALL", PARATYPE="FEED_GAIN", FeedGain=900, StayTime=100;
SET SPEEDPARA: OBJECT="ALL", PARATYPE="FILTER_TIME", FilterTime=900, StayTime=100;
STR RUNMODETASK: OBJECT="ALL", RUNMODE="FEEDFORWARD_POS", AMPLITUDE=10000, CYCLE=5, Interval=5, StayTime=2000000;

action.name: 关闭内部前馈
action.command: SET SPEEDPARA: OBJECT="ALL", PARATYPE="FEED_GAIN", FeedGain=0, StayTime=1000;
SET SPEEDPARA: OBJECT="ALL", PARATYPE="FILTER_TIME", FilterTime=0, StayTime=1000;

action.name: 转到0位置
action.command: SET SPEEDPARA: OBJECT="ALL", PARATYPE="FEED_GAIN", FeedGain=0, StayTime=100;
SET SPEEDPARA: OBJECT="ALL", PARATYPE="FILTER_TIME", FilterTime=0, StayTime=100;
SET RUNMODE: OBJECT="ALL", RUNMODE="POSITION", POSITION=0, StayTime=10000;
